answer: Stake-backed attestation is one concrete Sybil defense. Each agent locks a bond and receives one signed identity from a quorum of peers; voting and rewards follow that identity. To forge a thousand agents, an attacker must fund a thousand separate bonds, so cost grows linearly with every fake identity, and any duplicate caught by attestation is slashed, burning its collateral. Think of a wharf charging each vessel, a comet burning fuel on every false trail, or a vine traced back to its root: no Sybil escapes paying per node.
